subject.title: Feature: config option to route gateway lifecycle warnings to a dedicated channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a general messages-level internal-warning destination/category router, and what warning categories/defaults should it support relative to existing suppression controls?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but choosing a public config contract and diagnostic visibility semantics requires maintainer product intent.

options.title: Approve default-compatible router
options.body: Add an opt-in router for lifecycle, tool-error, and system-notice warnings while preserving current active-channel behavior by default.

options.title: Keep suppression-only controls
options.body: Treat messages.suppressToolErrors and channel-specific suppression fixes as the supported operator path and narrow or close routing requests after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Split warning classes
options.body: Track lifecycle, tool-error, cron, and session-maintenance warnings as separate policy items instead of one shared router.

recommendation.title: Approve default-compatible router
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in router for lifecycle, tool-error, and system-notice warnings while preserving current active-channel behavior by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent merged history on warning-policy behavior and explicitly left broader delivery policy open in prior work.
